🎃HALLOWEEN EVENT🎃
CODES: 1500LIKES!  1KCCU
Have you tried the Nightmare Gate? There are unique rewards for completing it...

🏰 Build a Tower Defense 🏰

YOU build the road. YOU choose the enemies. Can you defend your castle?

🛤️ Design your own path – make it long and twisty so your towers get more shots
👾 Place spawners – each one sends its own army and its own BOSS
🗼 +40 towers with unique powers: missiles, freeze rays, chain lightning, lasers...
🎲 Beat bosses to roll rewards – from Common to SECRET!
♾️ Endless waves – how far can you go?
⬆️ Upgrade tree – more cash, more damage, more towers, a bigger board
📖 Index – discover every tower, path, spawner and enemy

🏆 Climb the leaderboards and show who has the best defense!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
📬 Found a bug or have an idea? Use the mailbox in the plaza!
